open.trade: Long gold into the June Fed window
open.thesis: Pre-position into the 5 June payrolls / 16–17 June FOMC window. Gold has already decoupled from a 4.98% long bond, which means it is pricing both MoU tails at once. It wins if oil-disinflation forces a dovish Fed and real yields fall, AND it wins if the MoU fails and the geopolitical bid returns. It loses only on the narrow path of strong-growth + stable-oil + hawkish-Fed together. That is the asymmetry pre-positioning is built for; minimum 45-day hold, not an event-day scalp.

The Hormuz premium is Brent-specific — it prices the waterway, WTI prices Cushing. If the MoU frays, the Atlantic-basin grade reprices the de-mining risk and the spread widens; if it holds, physical caps the downside near current carry. A cleaner, lower-beta way to own the same re-escalation tail with defined spread risk.
